name: claude-code-docs
description: The Claude Code Docs as a plugin: an MCP server and a skill that answer questions about Claude Code 2.1.305.

plugins.name: cc-docs
plugins.description: MCP server and skill for the Claude Code Docs (version 2.1.305). Search and read pages, list sections, and get the JSON Schemas (search_docs, read_page, list_pages, get_schema). Also searches and reads the Claude API and platform docs (search_platform_docs, read_platform_page, list_platform_pages). Live fetch with an offline disk cache.
